limitations: Only C2 execution is credited; no C1 or C3 transfer.
Complete 10-run/23-job metadata and every full log verified, with raw source hashes preserved.
Rust semantic/harness coverage is the parent native auditor scope; this subreview independently checks non-Rust outcomes.
Strict Clippy fails in 10 jobs. Successful resource, growth and operator workloads do not accept C2 as a whole.
No local native workload, no downloaded executable was run, no fresh OS measurement collected by reviewer.
OS memory lifetime peaks exclude coordinator/supervisor and do not measure new incremental package CLI resources.
100000 local worker commits and about 15 MB do not establish 100000 consensus heights or full-capacity performance.
Operator bundle integrity/source binding is not code signing, independent reproducibility or external audit.
